# bioexcel/biobb_vs/fpocket_run

## Summary

Wrapper of the fpocket software.

Finds the binding site of the input_pdb_path file via the fpocket software.

Nextflow adapter of the [FPocketRun](https://biobb-vs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/fpocket.html#module-fpocket.fpocket_run) building block of [biobb_vs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_vs) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_VS_FPOCKET_RUN } from 'bioexcel/biobb_vs/fpocket_run'

workflow {
    BIOBB_VS_FPOCKET_RUN(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the PDB structure where the binding site is to be found |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pockets_zip` | yes | zip | Path to all the pockets found by fpocket in the input_pdb_path structure |
| `output_summary` | yes | json | Path to the JSON summary file |
| `versions_biobb_vs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_vs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of FPocketRun properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pockets_zip: 'zip']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_vs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_VS_FPOCKET_RUN' {
        ext.properties = [sort_by: 'druggability_score']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_radius` | number | null | The minimum radius in Ångstroms an alpha sphere might have in a binding pocket. |
| `max_radius` | number | null | The maximum radius in Ångstroms of alpha spheres in a pocket. |
| `num_spheres` | integer | null | Indicates how many alpha spheres a pocket must contain at least in order to figure in the results. |
| `sort_by` | string | "druggability_score" | From which property the output will be sorted. Values: druggability_score, score, volume. |
| `binary_path` | string | "fpocket" | path to fpocket in your local computer. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
